title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator,

translated_title: GeoWind2Plan：面向节能无人机规划的任务时间尺度三维城市风场预测
translated_abstract: 在城市低空飞行中，建筑物会将周围环境风重塑为空间变化的三维气流，使得无人机的能耗不仅取决于路径长度，还取决于局部风场暴露情况。然而，在需要规划任务时，建筑物分辨率的精细化风场信息往往难以获得。计算流体力学（CFD）能够生成高保真的城市流场，但每次模拟都绑定于固定的入流边界条件，且可能需要数小时至数天的时间，这与通常仅持续几分钟到几十分钟的城市无人机任务并不兼容。我们提出了GeoWind2Plan，这是一个“几何-风场-规划”框架，用于任务时间尺度的三维城市风场预测与节能无人机规划。仅给定一个背景风矢量、三维建筑几何形状和起点-目标对，GeoWind2Plan将建筑几何转换到参考风坐标系，利用局部化的几何条件神经算子预测与任务相关的三维风场切片，
tldr: 提出了GeoWind2Plan框架，仅凭建筑几何与背景风矢量即可在任务时间尺度内快速预测三维城市风场，并据此规划节能的无人机飞行路径。
en_tdlr: GeoWind2Plan is a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework that rapidly predicts mission-time 3D urban wind fields from building geometry and a background wind vector, enabling energy-efficient UAV path planning.
